summary: Removing the levitation ring enters trap.c:float_down() with a punished, uncarried ball over a pool and the chain separated at the midpoint. C moves the hero to the ball, calls hack.c:movobj(uchain, uball->ox, uball->oy), then redraws the old hero square. JavaScript skipped this caller and left the chain glyph at its old location. The fix calls the already implemented synchronous hack.js:movobj() after updating the hero coordinates and before redraw.

source.branch: When Punished is true, the ball is not carried, no monster occupies its square, and the ball is on pool/pit/hole terrain, float_down relocates the hero to the ball. It then calls movobj(uchain, uball->ox, uball->oy), redraws the old hero square, and requests full vision recalculation. JavaScript previously skipped this existing helper call.
